meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? Owen's zero.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite of what? You haven't shown me anything yet. What's the basis for the zero?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
I'm not most parents. Taking a rewrite now says Owen did something, and you haven't told me what. Put your reason on the table first.
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until I've seen what the zero stands on.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clear; that is not yet the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you named the rewrite and the clean record but never showed her anything that explained why the zero was given.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence and then called it generous, which made taking it sound like an admission and left her nothing to check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you put no evidence on the table, so you never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then show one dated document tied to Owen's own work before you mention the rewrite.
